Welcome back to Taboo Resume Advice… where we say the quiet part out loud.
In today’s episode:

STOP. BEING. SO. HONEST.

Because apparently the fastest way to not get a job…
…is to tell the truth on your resume.
In this video we break down a real resume and talk about why things that sound impressive can actually get you ghosted:

• Making $100K on a side project? Congrats… now they think you don’t need the job
• Listing side businesses or freelance work? Cool… now you look like a flight risk
• Calling yourself “junior” with 3 year
title: STOP BEING SO "HONEST" ON YOUR RESUME!
